scope: Strict requirement-by-requirement audit of H4 Revision 2.2 after the registered adjudicator returned VALID_NEGATIVE.

preregistration.requirement: The protocol becomes executable only after every pre-data lock in the implementation-readiness record is present, hashed, and committed.

requirements: Every Phase A row must be evidenced in one external freeze manifest.
Code quality requires syntax checks, targeted tests, and independent review PASS.
The go/no-go sign-off requires an evidence path/hash and PASS for Independent code review before calibration authorization.

failed_gate.finding: No authoritative committed evidence proves that the mandatory independent code review passed before calibration began.

coverage_gap.interpretation: The registered adjudicator correctly reproduces the scientific data and the gates it implements, but its valid flag is insufficient because the mandatory pre-data review gate is outside its coverage.

holdout_disposition.reason: All three H4a prefixes were empty. The missing pre-data review evidence supplies an additional global prohibition; it does not authorize a post-outcome repair or holdout run.

audit_limitations.outcome_noninspection: The transport freeze records an outcome-blind process and proves outcome artifacts were absent. Human noninspection of already-fetched calibration payload bytes is an operator assertion, not independently observable from Git.
audit_limitations.terminal_cloud_absence: The terminal absence JSON records verifier identity and boolean results but not raw signed AWS responses or request IDs. The live read-only replay corroborates it operationally; it is not an independently provenance-bound cloud receipt.

repairability.reason: The review evidence had to be present, hashed, committed, and bound before scientific generation. Creating it after outcomes would be retrospective gate repair.
repairability.permitted_next_step: Close H4 as protocol-invalid and descriptive. A confirmatory rerun requires a new experiment identifier, a corrected machine-enforced Phase A checklist, an authentic pre-data independent review artifact, and fresh calibration and holdout splits.

claim_boundary: The calibration observations and provenance-bound artifacts may be reported descriptively. H4 Revision 2.2 may not be called a protocol-valid negative, a certificate result, or a completed confirmatory experiment.
